tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Gauss--Bonnet formula on a sphere] 1. ch9:9-3↗ thm:gauss-bonnet-formula Given $h \in (-R, R)$, let $C_h$ be the circle in $S^2(R) \subseteq \mathbb {R}^3$ where $z = h$ (where we label the standard coordinates in $\mathbb {R}^3$ as $(x, y, z)$), and let $\Omega $ be the subset of $S^2(R)$ where $z > h$. Compute the signed curvature of $C_h$ and verify the Gauss--Bonnet formula in this case. \end{exercise}
